headline: Busy morning?
Start with God.
bullets: A new Bible verse every day
frames.scene: An ordinary woman in her mid-thirties at her kitchen counter before leaving in the morning. Coffee, toast, work bag, phone in hand and an earbud. She pauses to listen while making breakfast. Below the photo, a large Today verse card and a clear Listen button.
frames.jtbd: I want Scripture in my daily life, but the morning gets busy before I find time for it.

ui.title: Today’s verse
ui.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

frames.visualLimit: Fictional illustrative scene. Enlarged editorial app card. New daily content is implemented; specific KJV audio example still requires release verification. No duration guarantee.

headline: Feeling anxious?
Find your verse.
bullets: Bible verses for what you feel
frames.scene: An ordinary man around thirty on a commuter train after work. He sits by the window, looking thoughtfully at his phone. Anxious is selected in a large row of feelings above a relevant verse with its Bible reference. No dramatic tears or miraculous change of mood.
frames.jtbd: Something is weighing on me and I do not know where in the Bible to look for encouragement.

ui.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

frames.visualLimit: Fictional illustrative scene. Curated Scripture by state, not treatment or divinely personalized messages. Mood chips are inside the app, not a public Lock Screen.

headline: Too tired to read?
Listen & pray.
frames.scene: An ordinary woman around fifty sitting upright in bed at the end of the day. Reading glasses and a closed book on the bedside table; an earbud, a phone and a warm lamp. Eyes gently closed while listening, not sleeping. Below the photo is a clear evening prayer audio card.
frames.jtbd: I want to end my day with God, but I am too tired to read and need an easy way to listen and pray.

ui.title: Tonight
ui.verse: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

frames.visualLimit: Fictional illustrative scene. Audio sequence exists in code; the specific KJV verse and prayer must be tested before ASC. No promise to cure anxiety or make the user fall asleep.
